hook: A guy hugging his teddy bear at home just became a soldier saving his friend in war, and the performance never changed
caption:
This teddy bear hug just became a soldier saving his friend in a war zone 😳

Same actor, same take, same timing. An AI tool called TopviewAI Canvas swapped the living room for a WWI trench without touching a single frame of the original performance.

The emotion, the pacing, the little pauses, all of it carries straight through into the new scene.

Could you have told this wasn't filmed on location? 👇
